about: Philippine fertilizer products checked by hand (2026-10-12): brand, form and pack sizes, with the FPA registration, analysis and expiry from the FPA list of active registered fertilizers. Loaded into as_ph_fertilizers (App\Support\PhFertilizers::seedCurated); the monthly fertilizers:fpa-sync adds every other registered product.

fields.pct: percent by weight (w/w) unless basis is 'w/v'; P and K as P2O5 and K2O because every label states them so; Ca, Mg, S, Zn, B, Mn and Si are elemental, worked out from CaO x0.715, MgO x0.603, SO3 x0.4005, B2O3 x0.311, ZnO x0.803, MnO x0.775, SiO2 x0.467 where the label gave oxides (each such product says so in notes); ppm divided by 10,000; g/L divided by 10 (w/v)
fields.packs: sizes sold; packsVerified true only where a page I read showed that size (FPA weekly price bulletin for the standard 50 kg grades, Lazada PH for Yara repacks, UPLB for Bio N); otherwise the sizes are the usual ones for that kind of product and packsNote says so
fields.densityKgL: only where it can be worked out from the label's own w/v and w/w figures; null otherwise
fields.fpaReg / fpaExpiry / fpaCompany / fpaNam: copied from the FPA list of 15 Sep 2026 (the registration with the latest expiry when there are several)
